answer: Divergent-Response Identity Test. Each new identity must answer a freshly instantiated, hidden randomness challenge; honest agents answer from local state, clones answer identically. Require answers to differ along a canyon of unpredictable probes, like a unique opal pattern per response. Colluding attackers must maintain distinct internal state per clone, an oasis of costly isolated execution, so each identity pays independent compute and storage upkeep.
